name: Chapter 1: Sets
description: Sets, roster and set-builder forms, subsets, intervals, Venn diagrams, union, intersection, complement and De Morgan’s laws.

name: Chapter 2: Relations and Functions
description: Cartesian products, relations, domain and range, functions, standard graphs, modulus, signum and greatest integer, algebra of functions.

name: Chapter 3: Trigonometric Functions
description: Radian measure, trig functions and graphs, identities, compound and multiple angles, trig equations, and exam-style problems.

name: Chapter 4: Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations
description: Complex numbers, algebra, powers of i, modulus and conjugate, Argand plane, polar form, roots of unity and quadratic equations.

name: Chapter 5: Linear Inequalities
description: Inequalities, rules for solving, number-line graphs, double inequalities, systems, word problems, modulus and quadratic inequalities, half-planes.

name: Chapter 6: Permutations and Combinations
description: Counting principles, factorials, permutations with and without repetition, combinations, words, digits, committees, cards and exam techniques.

name: Chapter 7: Binomial Theorem
description: Pascal’s triangle, binomial theorem, special cases, general and middle terms, coefficients, approximations, divisibility and remainders.

name: Chapter 8: Sequences and Series
description: Sequences and series, G.P., geometric mean, AM–GM, plus A.P., infinite G.P. and special sums for exams.

name: Chapter 9: Straight Lines
description: Slope, angle between lines, forms of a line, distance formulas, concurrency, images and reflections, families of lines.

name: Chapter 10: Conic Sections
description: Cone sections, circle, parabola, ellipse, hyperbola: definitions, standard equations, eccentricity, latus rectum, applications and exam patterns.

name: Chapter 11: Introduction to Three Dimensional Geometry
description: Coordinate axes and planes, octants, coordinates of a point, distance formula, section formula and centroid in space.

name: Chapter 12: Limits and Derivatives
description: Intuitive derivative, limits and their algebra, standard trigonometric limits, first principle, derivative rules and standard derivatives.

name: Chapter 13: Statistics
description: Measures of dispersion: range, mean deviation, variance and standard deviation for ungrouped and grouped data, shortcut methods.

name: Chapter 14: Probability
description: Events and their algebra, axiomatic probability, addition rule, complement, equally likely outcomes, plus conditional probability and independence for exams.
